fieldNotes.siteResolution: Given coords (28.2461,-82.1811) landed in a residential grid ~2.7km NNW of the plant. Web search (lakerlutznews, tampabay) placed the Nestle/BlueTriton/Primo plant 'off 20th Street and Alston Avenue'. Google geocode of 4330 20th St, Zephyrhills FL 33542 returned 28.2220,-82.1693 which sits on the large white-roof industrial building. Locked center at 28.2215,-82.1688. This is the active Zephyrhills Natural Spring Water bottling factory (~250 employees).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View on the west access drive (pano 6r_ZKBZhREH3Pr_x9xbLOQ, captured 2025-05, heading ~82E) clearly shows a black sliding/ornamental metal gate across the entrance driveway with a card-reader/kiosk pedestal post on the right side of the lane. The entire property is wrapped in continuous black metal perimeter fencing (confirmed in multiple SV frames along 20th St). TRUE - controlled gated entry.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth-sized structure (1-3 vehicle footprint, multi-side windows) visible at the gate in Street View; access is by a sliding gate plus a card-reader/call-box pedestal beside the lane. FALSE.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: TRUE - there is a truck gate but no staffed guard shack; entry is by kiosk/card-reader/app at the pedestal. Medium confidence on the read of the pedestal as a remote check-in device.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single gated driveway on the west (20th St) serves both the employee/car lot (north) and the truck loop that wraps around the building's south side to reach the east dock bank and the drop yards. Same entrance point in and out -> entryExitTogether TRUE, single in/out lane pair.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: From the gate the drive runs a long internal loop (~0.3km) around the south of the building to the east yard; easily holds 3+ trucks before docks. Large open paved apron east of the docks also acts as internal staging -> postGateStaging TRUE.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Massive continuous dock bank on the building's EAST face running nearly the full building length (z19 east-docks crop shows ~30+ bays with trailers backed in across the visible portion, continuing north and south of frame). A second dock bank sits on a south/SW building face (z18 truck-route crop, trailers backed in). Honest total estimate ~55-60 doors across both faces -> banded 50+. Flagged uncertain: the east bank extends beyond single frames.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two physically distinct dock clusters on different building faces (long east face + a south/SW face bank) suggest split ship/receive flows. TRUE, medium confidence (function not confirmable from imagery).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Enormous trailer drop yard fills the entire east of the property: many parallel rows of trailers parked without tractors (z19 SE-docks crop shows 100+ trailers in rows), plus a second drop block on the south side. Banded 50+.
fieldNotes.dropYard: TRUE - dedicated multi-row trailer-storage lots east and south of the building, distinct from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Counted across z18/z19 crops: ~30+ at east docks, ~100+ in the east drop rows, ~15-20 in the south drop block. Conservative total ~130. Approximate from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: The striped drop-yard rows (east + south) plus dock positions could hold ~180 trailers at full pack.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~68 acres of fenced, paved/built footprint derived from the perimeter polygon (large building ~600m N-S building+yard span, ~500m E-W). Construction/expansion grading visible at the north end indicates active growth.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One very large contiguous industrial building (bottling + warehouse) under a single white roof, with a smaller attached section on the SW. Counted as 1 complex.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail corridor runs NW-SE west of 20th St through the residential area but does NOT enter the property; no spur into the yard. FALSE.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the City of Zephyrhills, immediately bordered by residential subdivisions (west) and a city park/ball fields (north) - dense town fabric -> Urban.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Gate sits well back from 20th St behind a deep curved driveway apron with ample stacking room; a queue would not spill onto the public road. FALSE.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale / weigh pad visible in the truck path. FALSE.
fieldNotes.imageryQuality: Mixed Maxar/Airbus vintages; the north end shows active construction (graded pads). Dock and trailer counts read from z18-z19 crops; large-facility counts are honest estimates, banded conservatively.
